_readme: talentsforever.com data export. Fan-made WoW Forever talent calculator; everything here was read off BlizzCon 2026 demo footage or Blizzard's own slides, so numbers can lag the live game. talents: per class, trees with talents (row/col are 1-based grid positions, max is the rank cap, desc maps rank number to tooltip text, confirmed lists ranks read verbatim, others are estimates; classic shows the Classic-era equivalent for comparison). spellbooks: level 38 demo spellbook pages per class. spell_desc: tooltip text keyed class|spell|rank, s=demo means read off footage, s=classic means Wowhead Classic fallback. racials and legacy: racial abilities and the Legacy perk trees. changelog: what changed on the site. Warrior.seen: Savix 4:36:54, Xaryu 5:01:27; Protection tab from Esfand's stream, clip by Zevzve, 13 Sep
notes: Baseline now: Victory Rush and Tactical Mastery. Tactical Mastery keeps up to 10 Rage through a stance change by itself; the Arms talent adds up to 15 more.
Mocking Blow still needs Battle Stance (10 Rage, 2 min cooldown). Thunder Clap works in Battle or Defensive Stance now. Both read off Soda's Warrior video.
Protection tab (Esfand's stream): Bloodrage, Defensive Stance, Disarm, Revenge, Shield Bash, Shield Block, Shield Wall, Sunder Armor, Taunt. No Last Stand, so that stays a talent.
Intercept isn't in the book at 38, where Classic teaches it at 30. Improved Intercept is in the Fury tree though, so it's learned later.
Retaliation: 15 min cooldown, Battle Stance, counters up to 30 melee hits for 15 sec.
Slam is rank 3 by 38 and has a 15 sec cooldown. Thunder Clap works in Defensive Stance too. Shield Wall is 15 min, 60% for 12 sec, and no longer shares a cooldown with Retaliation.
Undead Paladins are real. Cannibalize and Will of the Forsaken sit in the General tab.
Baseline now: Blessing of Kings, Consecration, Holy Strike and Seal of Fury. None of them are talents anywhere in the trees.
Seal of Command is still a Retribution talent. It's here because this Paladin took it.
Lay on Hands: 20 min cooldown, heals your full health, gives 250 mana, and empties your own mana.

Hunter.seen: Savix 5:07:09; Pet tab from Soda's owl, 5:04
notes: Baseline now: Aimed Shot, a Marksmanship talent in Classic. It's a 2 sec cast on a 6 sec cooldown shared with Multi-Shot.
Call Pet takes your pet's name. This one read Call Owl.
Earlier than Classic: Explosive Trap and Viper Sting are both trained by 38 (Classic: 44 and 36).

Traps: every trap tooltip we've read (Savix, Xaryu and Soda's Hunters) drops the Classic line 'Traps can only be placed when out of combat', and 'Only one trap can be active at a time' now reads one Fire trap or one Frost trap, so a Freezing Trap and an Immolation Trap may sit out together. Cooldown is 30 sec (Classic 15). Nobody has placed one mid-fight on stream yet, so treat in-combat trapping as what the tooltip says, not as tested. A reader (ericles26) spotted the missing line.
Pet tab is your pet's own book, read from Soda's owl. Growl rank 4 is a 15 Focus taunt on 5 sec, Dive is 20 Focus for 40% speed for 15 sec, Claw rank 5 hits 21 to 29, and Mine! is new: a disarm.
Beast Training still uses training points. Claw 1/8/16/24/32, Growl 1/10/20/30, Cower 5/15/25/35, Great Stamina and Natural Armor 24/30/36, Mine! 10/20/30/40/50, Dive 30, resistances 20 and 30.
Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush are Combat talents in Forever. They're here because this Rogue took them, not baseline.
No Riposte at 38 just means this Rogue hadn't taken it.
Blind: 30 Energy, 5 min cooldown, still needs Blinding Powder. Disarm Trap is still trained.
Baseline now: Fear Ward, in the Holy tab. Devouring Plague is a normal Shadow spell, rank 3 here on a Night Elf.
Troll racials: a level 38 Troll Shadow Priest on Xaryu's stream had Hex of Weakness rank 3 and Shadowguard rank 3 in the Shadow tab, plus Shadow Word: Pain rank 5 and Mind Blast rank 5.

Night Elf only: this book was read on a Night Elf, so Elune's Grace and Starshards were in it. They're racials, not Priest spells, so they live under Priest racials above, with the other races' pairs. A reader (Santum) caught it.
No Shadow Word: Death by 38. Talents mention it, so it comes later.
Ranks for Flash Heal, Heal, Renew, Power Word: Shield, Mind Blast, Holy Fire, Psychic Scream, Mind Control, Shadow Protection, Mind Vision and Divine Spirit come from that Troll Priest's tooltips.
New: Call of the Ancestors, Call of the Elements, Totemic Projection and Totemic Recall. Totemic Projection is ground-targeted: your totems move to the spot you pick, up to 30 yd away.
Fire Nova is a spell with ranks now (rank 3 by 38), not a totem: 30 yd, instant, 10 sec cooldown, hits everything within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.
Faster bolts: Lightning Bolt rank 7 is a 2.5 sec cast and Chain Lightning 2 sec, half a second quicker than Classic before any talents.
Earlier than Classic: Chain Lightning by 38 (Classic: 32). Windfury Totem and Windfury Weapon are both in.

Weapon buffs last 60 min: Rockbiter, Flametongue and Windfury Weapon all read 60 minutes. Windfury and Flametongue Weapon each turn off your own benefit from the matching totem when on your main hand. The wording only names the matching totem, so mixing (say Windfury Weapon plus Flametongue Totem) may stack. Nobody has tested it yet. Frostbrand still shows Classic text.

Hunter: Trainable now instead of a Marksmanship talent, and quicker: 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, shared with Multi-Shot (Classic was a 3 sec cast). Rank 3 by 38. A reader caught the cast time on Xaryu's stream.
Call Pet is named after your pet. The demo Hunter's read Call Owl.
Changed. Rank 1 makes you untrackable and adds 50 melee attack power. Classic was untrackable only. Spotted by a reader on Xaryu's stream.
Mage: New little ability: decipher an untranslated scroll. Seen on a Skyborne Mage.
A bolt that is both Fire and Frost. Four talents mention it.
Warlock: Curse of Agony, renamed. Bane of Doom the same. Banes and Curses are now separate, so you can run one of each.
Male counterpart to the Succubus, its own summon. Named by four Demonology talents.
Warrior: Baseline, in the Arms tab. Instant, 30 sec cooldown: a melee hit that heals you for 10% of your maximum health, usable within 20 sec of killing something non-trivial. Read off Soda's stream via a reader.

A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent. You keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances on your own, and the Arms talent Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more. Read off Soda's Warrior video via a reader.
Still in the game: the Fury tree has Improved Intercept. It just isn't in the level 38 spellbook, so it's probably learned later than 30 now.
Rank 3 by 38 (Classic reached that at 46) and it has a 15 sec cooldown now.
Changed. Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec and hits up to 4 targets, where Classic was 10% for 30. Read off Xaryu's stream, thanks to a reader.
Still there, in the Protection tab. 116 health for 10 rage plus 10 more over 10 sec.

Changed: 15 min cooldown, 60% less damage for 12 sec (Classic was 30 min, 75% for 10 sec). In Esfand's video it was ready while Retaliation was on cooldown, so the shared cooldown with Retaliation and Recklessness looks gone. Two readers flagged this.
Changed: 2 charges and 7 sec baseline (Classic was 1 block for 5 sec). Still 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, Defensive Stance. Read from a Tyler1 spellbook screenshot a reader sent in.
Rogue: New talent, Assassination row 5. Hits with both weapons for 75% damage each, 20% more on poisoned targets, and gives 2 combo points. Nine other talents feed it.
New finisher at the bottom of Assassination. Your poisons do 30% more and apply 10% more often, longer per combo point.
New Subtlety capstone. Each Rupture tick takes 3 Energy off your next Hemorrhage or Backstab, stacking to 5.
Rogues can use one-handed axes now. The Hack and Slash talent lists Axe/Sword as a weapon group.
Druid: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp
Both trainable now, not talents. They're in the Balance tab at 38.
New out-of-combat resurrection, 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.
Bear bleed from later expansions, in Forever as a baseline ability: the Shredding Attacks talent cuts its Rage cost. Not in the level 38 spellbook, so it comes later. Thanks to a reader.
Gone. Abolish Poison is the only poison cure.
Shaman: Half a second faster than Classic. Rank 7 is a 2.5 sec cast.
Also half a second faster: rank 1 is a 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 30% weaker. Max Elemental Alacrity brings Lightning Bolt to the same 2 sec.
New. Pick a spot up to 30 yd away and your totems move there, not just to your feet. Seen on Guzu's stream: a green circle on the ground, then the totems appear by the mob. Totemic Recall is in too.
New: drops up to four totems from your Totem Bar in one 3 sec cast.

Base cast is 2 sec now, down from 3 in Classic. Improved Ghost Wolf takes 1 sec per rank and lets it work indoors, so at 2/2 it is instant: that is what Guzu's tooltip showed. Readers caught both halves of this.

A spell now, not a totem: 30 yd range, instant, 10 sec cooldown, and it blasts everything within 10 yd of your active Fire totem (rank 3 does 206 to 231 at 38). Improved Fire Nova trims 2 sec off the cooldown. Read on Esfand's stream.

legacy.note: One Legacy point per challenge completed, spent across three account-wide trees. Nothing here is combat-related. Ranks shown as seen in the demo. The Professions tree also has two placeholder slots whose tooltip reads "To be added in future patch content". Each character can spend 16 Legacy points at launch, with 65 earnable in total and more trees to come, per the BlizzCon Deep Dive panel.

trees.name: Adventure
perks: Your rested experience accumulates 4% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 4%.
You gain talent points every level starting at level 9 instead of level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.
Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 1. Ineffective in battlegrounds.
You gain 1% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.
Reduces your cooldown on adding Camp features by 8%.
You receive a 50% discount on all flight paths, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.
Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 5 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

trees.name: Resourcefulness
perks: Increases movement speed while dead by 5% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 1 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.
You take 8% less durability loss when you die.
Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 50% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.
Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 33%.
Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchasable from vendors, and your Tier 1 camping features cost no reagents to craft.

trees.name: Professions
perks: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 4%.
You discover 20% more Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.
You have a 5% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.
While fishing with a lure active, you have a 25% chance to catch an extra fish.
Your cooking recipes have a 10% chance to create an extra result.

25 sec cast, 23 hour cooldown. Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary tradeskills and all three Secondary tradeskills, you gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.

changelog.title: Compare to Classic showed Season of Discovery markup on 20 talents
changelog.text: A reader hovered Trueshot Aura with Compare on and got raw override tags in the Classic text. The Classic reference came from Wowhead pages that carry Season of Discovery tweaks inline, and 20 talents had them: Trueshot Aura, Mortal Shots, Booming Voice, Natural Weapons and others. Every Classic text is vanilla now. Reader Darkthor69 caught it.

changelog.title: Ice Lance and Arcane Blast are talents, and a clearer full-build message
changelog.text: Two readers asked why Ice Lance and Arcane Blast are not on the new Mage abilities card. Both are talents in Forever, Ice Lance in row 3 of Frost and Arcane Blast in row 3 of Arcane, so they live in the tree with their real tooltips. I briefly put Ice Lance on the card by mistake this morning and a third reader caught it within the hour. Also, when all 51 points are spent the site now says so and tells you to take one back, instead of a vague no-points line. Another reader asked for points to move automatically; that is on purpose, the game makes you unlearn first.

changelog.title: Building on a phone feels like building on a desktop now
changelog.text: Tap a talent and the point goes in, with a see-through tooltip floating next to the icon: rank, the text, the next-rank numbers, and the Classic comparison when that's on. Taps pass straight through it. A small minus appears on the talent you just tapped to take a point back, and holding a talent reads it without spending. The old bottom sheet with Learn and Unlearn buttons is gone. A reader told us the phone version was rough, and they were right.

changelog.title: Long spellbook tooltips can be scrolled now
changelog.text: A Reddit reader hovering Paladin seals hit a tooltip taller than the book, and moving the mouse into it made it vanish. On a desktop the tooltip now stays put while your mouse is in it, and the wheel scrolls it whether you are over the spell or the tooltip. Phones were already fine.

changelog.title: Starshards and Elune's Grace out of the Priest spellbook
changelog.text: Both are Night Elf racials and were only in the book because the Priest we read was a Night Elf. They stay under Priest racials with every race's pair. A Discord reader caught it.

changelog.title: Spellbook tooltips now compare to Classic
changelog.text: Every spell read off footage says Same as Classic, New in Forever, or Changed from Classic with the exact words highlighted, plus the old cost or cooldown line when that moved. 108 spells changed, 71 match, 50 are new. Spells still on Classic text keep saying so until they get read in beta. A Discord reader asked for this one.

changelog.title: Thick Hide rank 2 read off footage
changelog.text: A reader sent a Feral Druid video with a point in Thick Hide: rank 2 is 2 Armor per level and 1.33 per defense point, so the site now shows the real text there and 3 and 2 at rank 3. If your copy still says 1 Armor at every rank, that's an older cached build; reload the page.

changelog.title: Hunter traps: the out-of-combat line is gone
changelog.text: A reader noticed our trap tooltips never say traps must be placed out of combat. That's not us trimming: all three Hunter spellbooks we read (Savix, Xaryu, Soda) drop that Classic line, and the one-trap rule now reads one Fire trap or one Frost trap. Cooldown is 30 sec instead of 15. Added a note on the Hunter spellbook page; whether it actually works mid-fight is untested until beta.

changelog.title: Tactical Mastery keeps 10 Rage; Mocking Blow still needs Battle Stance
changelog.text: A reader watched Soda's Warrior deep dive: the baseline Tactical Mastery passive reads 10 Rage kept through a stance change, not the 5 we had from Classic, and the Arms talent adds up to 15 more at 5/5 (that rank 5 text is now read verbatim instead of estimated). Mocking Blow's tooltip shows Requires Battle Stance, which the Classic import had dropped. Both tooltips are on the Warrior spellbook page now.

changelog.title: Human Sword Specialization counts auto attacks
changelog.text: A reader checked Soda's Warrior video: the racial reads 'all spells and attacks', not spells and abilities, so white hits get the 2% crit too. Fixed the wording. Also the line under the logo now follows the class you pick instead of the one the page opened on, and the Druid spellbook notes explain why Hurricane isn't in a level 38 book.

changelog.title: Priest racials filled in
changelog.text: A reader pointed at Warcraft Tavern's demo-floor screenshots of all twelve Priest racials. Human Feedback and Undead Touch of Weakness were missing, and the Dwarf and Gnome entries had no numbers. All in now with rank 1 mana, cooldowns and values, alongside the level 38 ranks we already had.

changelog.title: Puncturing Wounds ranks 2 and 3 fixed, and a smarter estimator
changelog.text: A reader noticed Puncturing Wounds kept 10% and 5% crit at every rank. Our rank estimator only scaled the combo point chance. Fixed, and the same mistake was caught on Natural Reaction, Serrated Blades, Resourcefulness, Aftermath, Winter's Chill and a few others. Estimates now round the way Classic does (17/33/50 instead of 17/34/51), fill in between two read ranks instead of stretching one, and no longer cap Predatory Strikes at 100%. Estimated ranks are still marked Estimated.

changelog.title: Windfury Weapon, read off a reader's screenshot
changelog.text: Rank 1: 20% chance of 2 extra attacks with 103 attack power, 60 minutes, and it turns off your own Windfury Totem benefit when it's on your main hand. Flametongue Weapon has the same line about Flametongue Totem. Whether a weapon imbue stacks with a different totem is an open question.

changelog.title: Totemic Projection is ground-targeted
changelog.text: A reader pointed at Guzu's stream: Totemic Projection puts a green circle on the ground and your totems move there, up to 30 yd away, not to your feet. The Shaman abilities card said the opposite. Fixed. The same footage shows Ghost Wolf instant on Guzu, who had Improved Ghost Wolf 2/2, which is what the spellbook already says.

changelog.title: Compare to Classic shows the Classic text again
changelog.text: A reader noticed the Classic text had gone missing from compare tooltips. Tonight's confirmed-rank data stored some talents differently and the compare block was reading the wrong rank. Fixed: Classic and Forever side by side again, with the changes highlighted, on desktop and in the phone sheet. Also on phones, spellbook tooltips now open as a sheet at the bottom of the screen instead of getting cut off inside the book. And the raw data now carries a CC BY 4.0 licence: use it however you like, credit talentsforever.com with a link.

changelog.title: Theorycraft with an AI
changelog.text: New Theorycraft row under the trees. Copy build for AI puts your build on the clipboard with the full tooltip text of every talent you picked, so you can paste it into Claude or whatever you use and ask what to change. Next to it, Class data gives you that class as plain JSON (talents at every rank, spellbook, tooltips, racials) and All data is the whole site in one file at talentsforever.com/data.json. A reader pointed out that hover text is invisible to an LLM, which is fair.

changelog.title: Pages turn
changelog.text: Paging through a spellbook on a desktop now turns the leaf over the spine, with the next page printed on its back, instead of the old fade. Phones keep the quicker flip. The green line under a tooltip now says outright that the text was read off BlizzCon demo footage.

changelog.title: 174 real spell tooltips
changelog.text: Went back through every spellbook page Soda, Savix and Xaryu opened on stream and read the tooltips off the footage. 174 spells now show the real Forever text in green instead of the Classic fallback, across all nine classes: every Paladin seal and blessing, the Shaman totems and shocks, Druid forms and cat and bear abilities, the Rogue openers and finishers, Hunter traps and aspects, Mage armors and wards, Warlock curses and stones, Priest heals and shadow spells. Notable reads: Slam has a 15 sec cooldown, Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot, Frost Trap slows 60%, Eviscerate scales with Attack Power, Blessing of Protection and Divine Shield apply Forbearance, Blind is 30 energy on 5 min, and Skysight and Read Ley Line last 15 min when you find a convergence or ley line. Damage numbers include whatever gear and talents that streamer had, and the source line under each tooltip says whose character it was. Racial cards got the same treatment.

changelog.title: Spellbook tooltips
changelog.text: Hover a spell in any spellbook (tap on a phone) and you get its tooltip. Where we have read the real thing off demo footage it says so in green. Everywhere else it shows the Classic text and says plainly that Forever may differ. A reader asked for this an hour ago.

changelog.title: Real max-rank numbers from Soda's stream
changelog.text: Soda spent his talent points before hovering, so his tooltips show the real text at the ranks he bought. Thirty-odd talents across all nine classes now carry the actual rank text instead of our estimate: Furor, Heart of the Wild, Hack and Slash, Dual Wield Specialization, Maelstrom Weapon, Renewed Hope, Shadow and Flame, Improved Blizzard and more. Where a rank is still estimated the tooltip still says so. Also new: the Hunter Pet tab and the Warlock Destruction and Pet tabs in the spellbooks, and Bountiful Harvest in the Professions Legacy tree.

changelog.title: Sanctified Judgement, Dwarf and Undead racials
changelog.text: Sanctified Judgement now scales both numbers: rank 3 is a 100% chance to return 60% of the mana, read straight off a rank 3 of 3 tooltip on Savix's stream after a reader flagged it. Dwarf and Undead racials rewritten from Blizzard's own Deep Dive slides: Stoneform is a 3 min cooldown with 10% less physical damage, Cannibalize ticks 7% health and mana every 2 sec, Touch of the Grave is a 5% chance capped at 5% of your health.

changelog.title: Shaman bolts are faster
changelog.text: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cast half a second faster than Classic before you spend a talent point, read from tooltips on Guzu's stream that a reader sent in. That is why Elemental Alacrity only trims 0.5 sec at 3 of 3: deep Elemental ends up right where Classic did. On the Shaman page under Abilities.

changelog.title: Paladin taunt, Legacy cap, dual spec
changelog.text: From the BlizzCon Deep Dive: Judgement no longer eats your seal and judging Seal of Fury taunts, so Paladins can tank for real. Legacy is 16 points per character at launch, 65 earnable. The talent window has a locked Secondary tab, so dual spec is coming. Furor now scales its energy line too, thanks to a reader.

changelog.title: Checked against the Deep Dive slides
changelog.text: Read Blizzard's Paladin talent slides from the panel at full size and compared all nineteen tooltips to ours. Wording matched on every one. One rank estimate was off: Shield Specialization now scales the absorb too, 30% at 3 of 3, as the slide shows.

changelog.title: Weaponmaster ranks
changelog.text: All three weapon lines now scale with rank, not just the sword one. A reader caught it. Still an estimate from the rank 1 tooltip until the beta.

changelog.title: Warrior Protection tab
changelog.text: The one spellbook tab we were missing. Read from a clip of Esfand's stream a reader sent in: Bloodrage, Shield Wall, Taunt, Sunder Armor and the rest. Overpower corrected to rank 2 while we were in there.

changelog.title: Troll Priest spells
changelog.text: Hex of Weakness and Shadowguard are confirmed for Troll Priests, read from demo spellbook tooltips a Reddit reader shared. Hex now cuts attack power instead of flat damage. Under Racials on the Priest page.

changelog.title: Spellbooks look like the real thing
changelog.text: The spellbook under each class is now a proper book: parchment pages, tabs down the side, real spell icons, and the page turns. Warlock also shows the level every rank is trained at, read from Crixx's stream at the Goldshire trainer. The other eight classes get their levels when the beta opens.

changelog.title: Rogue arrows
changelog.text: Four prerequisite arrows were missing in the Rogue trees: Deflection to Riposte, Precision to Dual Wield Specialization, Blade Flurry to Weapon Expertise, Dirty Deeds to Quietus. Confirmed on Xaryu's stream. Builds that skipped the prerequisite will need a point moved.

changelog.title: Tooltips on desktop
changelog.text: The tooltip now parks next to the talent instead of chasing your mouse. At the next rank, the numbers that change are picked out in white.

changelog.title: Your Reddit catches
changelog.text: Blade Flurry and Seal of Command are talents again, not baseline. Consecration and Blessing of Kings read as trainer spells in Compare to Classic instead of removed. Improved Expose Armor rank 2 confirmed from Soda's stream.

changelog.title: Spellbooks for all nine classes
changelog.text: Every trainer spell the level 38 demo characters had, read tab by tab from Savix's and Xaryu's streams. Under Racials.

changelog.title: Racials from footage
changelog.text: Night Elf Priest racials and Victory Rush confirmed. Elune's Grace changed. Everything cites the stream and timestamp it came from.

changelog.title: Save and share
changelog.text: My builds and Share sit under the trees now. Load a saved build from the toolbar. Copy a build as text. Shared links show the class icon.

changelog.title: Legacy perks
changelog.text: The three account-wide Legacy trees, collapsed under Racials.

changelog.title: Phones
changelog.text: Tap a talent to read it, tap again to add a point, hold to remove one.

changelog.title: Launched
changelog.text: All nine classes, read from the BlizzCon 2026 demo tooltips and checked frame by frame.
